Look at `BalanceCard` component: there is a badge with 2 buttons ('Пополнить', 'Вывести'). So, that badge oferflow the card if card has enough small width, but can we make `flex-shrink: 0` similiar behaviour for the card to avoid hidden overflowinf of inner content?
I’ll inspect `BalanceCard` and its parent layout to see whether the card can opt out of shrinking without breaking the surrounding responsive behavior.

content.text: The card is a CSS Grid item in both usages, so `shrink-0` alone won’t govern its width. I’m adding an intrinsic minimum width (`min-w-min`) to make the card expand before its badge gets clipped; `shrink-0` will also cover any future flex-parent usage.

The card visually extends into the second column while the referral link retains an invisible clickable area over it. I’ll make the parent grid respect the card’s intrinsic minimum width and let the referral button take the remaining space.
